headlines.summary: Adobe has been named the Official AI Fan Experience Partner for the BWT Alpine Formula One Team to enhance global fan engagement through AI-powered tools.

headlines.headline: Orangetheory Fitness Launches OTconnect for Apple Watch
headlines.summary: Orangetheory Fitness has introduced its OTconnect platform for Apple Watch in the U.S., allowing members to sync their devices for real-time performance tracking during classes.
